newsitem.title: FRANCE: France's Chirac, Juppe recover in popularity poll.
newsitem.headline: France's Chirac, Juppe recover in popularity poll.

text.p: The popularity of French President Jacques Chirac and Prime Minister Alain Juppe recovered in the past month although voters dissatisfied with them remained a large majority, an opinion poll said on Saturday.

The IFOP survey of 1840 voters released ahead of publication in the weekly Journal du Dimanche on Sunday said the two leaders gained four percentage points each to reach 34 percent popularity for Chirac and 29 percent for Juppe.
The percentage of dissatisfied voters decreased slightly but remained far higher, at 55 percent for Chirac and 61 percent for Juppe.
The two leaders' popularity had fallen to record lows over persistent record unemployment and budget austerity aimed at enabling France to join the single European currency in 1999.
